key_insight: Flow-OPD applies on-policy distillation to Flow Matching text-to-image models, turning sparse scalar rewards and entangled gradient signals into richer, on-policy supervision that prevents the 'seesaw effect' and reduces reward hacking.
problem_solved: Existing FM text-to-image models struggle under multi-task alignment because scalar-valued rewards are sparse and jointly optimizing heterogeneous objectives causes gradient interference — producing competing metrics and pervasive reward hacking.
method: Post-training On-Policy Distillation: run on-policy rollouts from a teacher/policy and distill its behavior into the Flow Matching student model to provide denser, trajectory-level supervision.

Decouple heterogeneous objectives: replace or augment scalar reward supervision with on-policy signals (e.g., per-sample/trajectory guidance and distilled logits/flows) to reduce gradient interference and stabilize multi-objective updates.
Unified alignment pipeline: a lightweight post-training stage that balances multi-metric alignment (via loss weighting or modular heads) while preserving generative quality of the original FM model.
impact: Flow-OPD makes multi-objective alignment for Flow Matching text-to-image models more stable and robust, enabling practitioners to optimize competing metrics reliably and reduce reward-hacking without retraining from scratch.
